name: Dillus Farfog
text: Dillus Farfog, also called Dillus the Bearded, was a Welsh giant of legend. One of the tasks set for Culhwch in courting Olwen was to obtain hair from the beard of Dillus Farfog. The hair was needed to make a leash for the great boar Twrch Trwyth. It was also needed for the hound Drudwyn. Daunting as the task was, Culhwch accomplished it with little trouble. In a separate tradition Cei and Bedwyr also fashion a leash from the beard of Dillus Farfog. The giant's name itself means the bearded one in Welsh. See the Culhwch ac Olwen entry for the wider story.
